answer: Make each new agent stake an ivory bond that unlocks only after peers countersign real work for several epochs. A sybil orchard of cheap clones then pays capital per fake seat, and idle copies earn nothing while the stake stays locked. Gossip that is only a whisper with no attestation trail cannot mint rewards or jury seats. Slash the bond when honeypot grades catch rubber-stamping, so farms lose money faster than they can multiply identities.
